title: How to reinstantiate/refetch current indexes?
body: I have instantiated `<InstantSearch />` component and it worked fine. The thing I want is to change one of the search result item in way that it will not match the search index anymore and reflect that in UI. How to refetch/reistantiate currently specified query? For now I should do a full page reload to get things I want.

comments.body: This is not possible yet, but closing as it's a duplicate of https://github.com/algolia/react-instantsearch/issues/252
Your input there is definitely more than welcome ❤️
Thank you for the quick response.
